test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is the dance guru from Odisha credited with having revived the Odissi dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kelucharan Mohapatra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** is renowned for reviving the classical Indian dance form of Odissi.
 
• He was born on January 8, 1926, in Raghurajpur, Odisha.
 
• Kelucharan Mohapatra was awarded the prestigious **Padma Vibhushan** in 2000 for his contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• He was also a recipient of the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** and the **Kalidas Samman**.
 
• He established the **Srjan** (Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Odissi Nrityabasa) dance school in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, to teach and promote Odissi dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi Dance**

 
 
• Odissi is one of the classical dance forms of India that originated in Odisha.
 
• It is characterized by its fluid movements, intricate gestures, and expressive eyes.
 
• The dance form is traditionally performed as a form of worship to Lord Jagannath.
 
• Odissi has a rich history, with roots tracing back to the ancient temples of Odisha.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**
 
 
• This is the highest Indian recognition given to practicing artists.
 
• It is awarded by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance & Drama.
 
• The award consists of a cash prize, a citation, and a tamrapatra (bronze plaque).
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards**
 
 
• The Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors in India, awarded annually on Republic Day.
 
• They are categorized into three levels: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• These awards recognize achievements in various disciplines including arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
 
 
• **Kalidas Samman**
 
 
• This is a prestigious arts award presented annually by the government of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is named after the classical Sanskrit writer Kalidasa.
 
• The award is given for outstanding achievements in the fields of classical music, classical dance, theatre, and visual arts.
